import sys, struct
sys.path.insert(0,'project')
from collector import Case, PRIM_INDEX

def run(case, evs, trace=0):
    c = Case(PRIM_INDEX[case['primitive']], case['mode'], case['root'],
             case['segments'], case['words'], case['capacity'], case['start'], trace)
    c.replay(evs)
    return c

def st(c): return c.state_list()

print("=== blocked / duplicate / stale ===")
case = dict(primitive='allreduce', mode=3, root=0, segments=4, words=1, capacity=1, start=0)
c = run(case, [{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0}])
print('after p0 r0:', st(c))
c = run(case, [{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0},{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':1}])
print('then p1 r0 (blocked):', st(c), 'blocked?', st(c)[24])
c = run(case, [{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0},{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0}])
print('duplicate p0 r0:', st(c), 'dup?', st(c)[23])
# retire p0: need all sources, outputs acked, U>0
evs=[{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0} for r in range(4)]
evs+=[{'op':'ack','rank':d,'upto':1} for d in range(4)]
evs+=[{'op':'flush'}]
c = run(case, evs)
print('after full p0 + acks:', st(c), 'b =', st(c)[0])
c = run(case, evs+[{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0}])
print('stale after retire:', st(c), 'stale?', st(c)[25], 'R0', st(c)[2])

print()
print("=== budget: zero budget blocks everything ===")
case = dict(primitive='allreduce', mode=3, root=0, segments=1, words=1, capacity=1, start=0)
c = run(case, [{'op':'budget','n':0},{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0}])
print('state', st(c), 'fail', st(c)[29], 'packets', c.packets)
c = run(case, [{'op':'budget','n':1},{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0},{'op':'data','rank':1,'p':0}])
print('budget1: ack r0 ok, ack r1 fails:', st(c), 'fail', st(c)[29], 'U', st(c)[14:18])

print()
print("=== retry phase2 retransmission ===")
case = dict(primitive='allreduce', mode=3, root=0, segments=1, words=1, capacity=1, start=0)
evs=[{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0} for r in range(4)]
evs+=[{'op':'budget','n':0},{'op':'retry','rank':2}]
c = run(case, evs, trace=8)
print('state', st(c), 'fail', st(c)[29])
c = run(case, evs+[{'op':'budget','n':-1},{'op':'retry','rank':2}])
print('after retry with budget: packets', c.packets, 'txdata', st(c)[20], 'S', st(c)[6:10], 'A', st(c)[10:14])
for t in c.trace: print('   ', t[0], bytes.fromhex(t[1])[42], int.from_bytes(bytes.fromhex(t[1])[50:54],'big')&0xffffff)
